hook: 3 months of no rent. Then she opened the door.
cta_sub: We buy rentals as-is, tenants or not. Florida only.

beats.say: My tenant stopped paying three months ago. Then they just left.
Holes in the walls. The carpet is ruined. There's trash everywhere.
And now I'm supposed to spend thousands fixing it, so I can do this all over again?
Rosa, I'm Casa. Can I ask you something? Do you actually want to be a landlord anymore?
No. I'm exhausted. I just want out.
Then you don't have to fix a thing. We buy rentals as is. Holes, carpet, trash, all of it.
You'd buy it like this? People are going to lowball me.
We show you exactly how we got to our number. Repair costs, what similar homes sold for. You see the math, and there's no obligation.
My other unit still has a tenant in it.
That's okay. We buy properties with tenants in place all the time.
We can close in as few as twenty one days, through a local title company. You pick the date.
No more three AM calls about a broken toilet.
Tired landlords in Florida, DM the word OFFER, and we'll make you a cash offer on your rental, as is.
